gmdn_terms.definition: An multicomponent assembly of electrically-powered devices designed to locate a nerve by applying an electrical stimulus with a probe and observing muscle responses. Once the pathways are located, their transmission capabilities can be assessed by comparing observed muscle responses with the expected maximum contractions.
